title: Policy Targeting with Market Equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2609.18600v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a framework for individualized treatment allocation when interventions shift equilibrium prices and generate spillovers across treated and untreated units. The planner chooses which units receive a subsidy while allowing equilibrium prices to adjust endogenously. We show that the resulting welfare function is supermodular under broad and interpretable conditions, implying complementarity across treatment assignments and enabling exact polynomial-time optimization. This structure clarifies how equilibrium spillovers shape the trade-off between universal and targeted distribution and makes the planner's problem computationally tractable despite interactions across units. We characterize when universal or targeted subsidies are optimal and show how market conditions and heterogeneity shape the optimal allocation. translated_title: 市场均衡下的政策定向
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个框架，用于处理当干预措施改变均衡价格并在受处理与未受处理单位之间产生溢出效应时的个体化处理分配问题。规划者选择哪些单位获得补贴，同时允许均衡价格进行内生调整。我们证明，在广泛且可解释的条件下，所得的福利函数是超模的，这意味着处理分配之间存在互补性，并使得精确的多项式时间优化成为可能。这一结构阐明了均衡溢出效应如何塑造普遍分配与定向分配之间的权衡，并使规划者的问题在单位间存在相互影响的情况下仍具有计算上的可处理性。我们刻画了何时普遍补贴或定向补贴是最优的，并展示了市场条件与异质性如何塑造最优分配。我们进一步为需求与[供给]估计不确定性下的代入式分配建立了统计保证……
tldr: 本文提出了一个考虑市场均衡价格内生调整与跨单位溢出效应的个体化补贴分配框架，证明福利函数的超模性使最优定向分配可被精确且高效地求解，并刻画了普遍补贴与定向补贴各自最优的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework for individualized subsidy allocation under market equilibrium with spillover effects, proving that the welfare function is supermodular—enabling exact polynomial-time optimization—and characterizing when universal or targeted subsidies are optimal.
